concepts.title: State
concepts.summary: State stores values that live inside a component instance.

concepts.title: Render
concepts.summary: Rendering is when React updates the UI from component state and props.

concepts.title: Props
concepts.summary: Props are inputs passed from parent components to children.

concepts.title: Component
concepts.summary: A component is a reusable unit of UI.

concepts.title: Hooks
concepts.summary: Hooks are functions that let function components use React features.

concepts.title: useState
concepts.summary: useState lets a component hold local state.

concepts.title: useEffect
concepts.summary: useEffect runs side effects after render.

concepts.title: useContext
concepts.summary: useContext reads a value from context without prop drilling.

concepts.title: Memoization
concepts.summary: Memoization avoids unnecessary recomputation or rerendering.

concepts.title: Dependency array
concepts.summary: The dependency array tells effect code when to rerun.

concepts.title: Cleanup
concepts.summary: Cleanup handles teardown work when an effect is removed or rerun.

concepts.title: Event handlers
concepts.summary: Event handlers respond to user actions like clicks and typing.

concepts.title: Controlled input
concepts.summary: A controlled input stores its value in state.

concepts.title: Derived state
concepts.summary: Derived state is computed from current props or other state instead of stored independently.

concepts.title: Re-render
concepts.summary: A re-render happens when React updates the component tree after changes.

concepts.title: Immutability
concepts.summary: Immutability means not mutating objects or arrays in place.

concepts.title: Effect order
concepts.summary: Effects run after the paint, in the order they are declared.

concepts.title: Context
concepts.summary: Context is a way to share values across a component tree without prop drilling.

concepts.title: Custom hook
concepts.summary: A custom hook packages reusable stateful logic.

concepts.title: useCallback
concepts.summary: useCallback memoizes a function between renders.

concepts.title: memo
concepts.summary: memo prevents rerenders when props are unchanged.

concepts.title: useRef
concepts.summary: useRef stores a mutable value that survives renders without causing rerenders.

concepts.title: Lifecycle
concepts.summary: Lifecycle is the sequence of mount, update and unmount phases.
